# Locale review sheet: 한국어 (ko)

<!-- Generated by tools/i18n/build-locale-review.mjs from the locale files. Do not edit by hand. -->

Status: ai-draft. Reviewed by: nobody yet. Reviewed on: not yet.
HTML language tag: `ko`. USCIS publishes civics material in this language.

## How to review

Read each row. For each translation, check that it says the same thing as the English, in words a speaker of this language would use. Mark anything stiff, wrong or unnatural. The English column is the source of truth.
To record a review, fill `reviewedBy` and `reviewedOn` in `_meta` of `src/i18n/locales/ko.json` and set `source` to `human-reviewed`. The AI label then disappears for this language.

## Lines marked ⚠ (meaning differs a little)

- `compare.counts`: "This counts" is rendered "is accepted" (인정됩니다), a little stronger than "counts".
- `intro.locked`: "Answer key" is rendered "answer table" (정답표); fine in context.
